provenance.construction: Dense-packed surface code of arXiv:2511.06758 (Fujiu et al.), distance 13: five rotated surface-code patches fused via code deformation into one weight-4 patch, reconstructed from the authors' released stim simulation. Matches the board's [[101,5,5]] and [[197,5,7]] members of the same family.
provenance.notes: Extends the dense-packed surface-code family to distance 13, the largest member under the n<=700 cap. At r=sqrt(2), rho=1, g = kd^2/n = 1.248. Not dominated by any board code in the weight-4 x local-2d-single cell.
